entities.summary: Robert James Zdarsky, better known by his stage name Robert Z'Dar, was an American character actor and film producer, best known for his role as officer Matt Cordell in the cult slasher film Maniac Cop (1988) and its two sequels, as well as appearances in Tango & Cash (1989) and Samurai Cop (1991).
